svg.title: Thibaut Platet — XR & Simulation Software Engineer
svg.desc: Unreal Engine 5 / C++ · Unity / C# · VR / AR · AI. Available immediately for permanent or fixed-term roles. Based in Paris, open to relocation in France and abroad. An animated orrery, as on the portfolio, shows experience and projects as planets and moons: Bilan Carbone; ENEDIS; SOLAS (moons: Mystic Minigolf, ARmageddon, Vert le Chemin); TerraPolis (moons: The Undead Clock, Eye-Tracking); CEA-List.
